images.name: cover
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a premium editorial illustration for a B2B restaurant glassware buying guide, landscape 3:2, no text or logos. A clean stainless steel commercial wash-up workbench in a neutral warm ivory and muted sage kitchen. Main subject: a single generic square gray dishwasher glass rack with a physically coherent 4-by-4 grid of separate compartments, containing a small number of identical transparent straight tumblers placed upside down, one glass per cell, with ample space and no glass-to-glass contact. On the workbench beside it are one upright clear tumbler, an upright handled drinking jar, a slim ruler lying flat, and a simple clipboard. Soft daylight, calm architectural composition, slightly elevated three-quarter view, restrained realistic 3D editorial illustration rather than documentary photography. Show plausible glass geometry and rack construction. This is a conceptual illustration of checking equipment fit, not a product test, no branded equipment, no numerical measurements, no labels, no hands, no people, no duplicated glass rims, no glass intersecting rack dividers. Render high quality transparent glass and understated material detail.

images.name: dimensions
images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Landscape 3:2 premium editorial educational illustration for a restaurant glassware procurement article. Warm ivory background, charcoal fine linework, muted sage dimension arrows, soft realistic transparent glass. Show three clean isolated glass silhouettes in an evenly spaced horizontal row: left a straight-sided tumbler, center a stemmed wine glass with a bowl wider than its rim, right a handled drinking jar with its handle fully visible on the right. Each upright on the same baseline. Left tumbler has one vertical double-ended dimension arrow OUTSIDE its left edge from bottom of base to top of rim, labeled exactly 'Overall height'. Center wine glass has one horizontal double-ended arrow above the bowl with thin extension lines dropping to the widest bowl edges, labeled exactly 'Maximum diameter'. Right jar has a horizontal double-ended arrow below it with extension lines to the leftmost body and rightmost handle edges, labeled exactly 'Width including handle'. Top title exactly 'Measure the outside profile'. Small bottom note exactly 'Illustrative only - not measured product specifications'. Be technically coherent; do not place numerical measurements, scales, volume values or recommended clearances. Labels crisp and readable with generous spacing, avoid crossed arrows, no equipment brands, no product logos, no other text, no watermarks. Polished print editorial graphic, not a product photograph.

images.name: storage
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a sophisticated landscape 3:2 editorial illustration for a restaurant glassware guide about checking shelf and trolley storage. Consistent warm ivory, muted sage gray and charcoal palette, realistic transparent glass rendered as restrained architectural 3D illustration, soft daylight. Simple restaurant back-of-house scene. A modest stainless steel open shelf on the right contains two generic straight clear tumblers standing upright well separated, no nesting, no stacking. A compact stainless steel trolley on the left holds one empty square gray compartmented glass washing rack. Show clear usable space above rack and above glasses. A small blank checklist clipboard and pencil on a counter edge in the foreground. Carefully drawn coherent shelf perspective, straight metal tubing and real-world plausible rack depth. Plenty of uncluttered negative space. No people, no brand marks, no numbers, no measurement arrows, no text, no watermark. This depicts a planning concept, not certified storage, a real Glarivo product or an actual test. Avoid glass intersecting objects, floating objects, complex machinery and decorative restaurant styling.
